papers.title: Effect of heat treatment on the microstructure and superelasticity of NiTi alloy via selective laser melting
papers.abstract: In this study, a Ni50.4Ti49.6 shape memory alloy (SMA) was fabricated by selective laser melting (SLM), and it is found that heat treatments were effective to change the phase transformation behavior, microstructure, and superelasticity under compression for SLM Ni50.4Ti49.6. Detailed results based on EBSD demonstrated that, for SLM Ni50.4Ti49.6 during solid solution and aging (450 °C) treatment, the ultrafine cellular and columnar grains (∼16.5 μm) in as-fabricated Ni50.4Ti49.6 became equiaxed grains (∼70.2 μm), and the frequency of low-angle grain boundaries (26.7%→13.5%) and kernel average misorientation (0.37 → 0.21) decreased. The SEM and TEM analyses show that Ti-rich Ti2Ni/Ti4Ni2Ox and Ni-rich Ni4Ti3 precipitate phases were formed in the matrix simultaneously. After solid solution treatment, the size and distribution of Ti2Ni/Ti4Ni2Ox almost unchanged with aging temperature increasing from 350 °C to 550 °C, however, the size of Ni4Ti3 in aging-treated NiTi samples increased with aging temperature obviously, and it is interesting to find that the distribution of Ni4Ti3 became uneven and dislocation networks were formed in the matrix when the aging treatment reached up to 550 °C, which originated from the internal stress generated by supersaturated Ni atoms. Furthermore, the results of superelasticity for aging-treated NiTi demonstrated that the characteristics of Ni4Ti3 precipitate phase were powerful to influence the process of superelasticity decay/fatigue instead of determining the ultimately recovery strain after 10 compressive cycles. The aging-treated NiTi with evenly-distributed, high-density, and relatively-small Ni4Ti3 precipitate phase shows minimum recovery strain at 1st cycle compression and best superelasticity stability among three aging-treated NiTi, which was attributed to strong obstruction effect of these Ni4Ti3 precipitate for the occurrence of stress-induced martensitic transformation process and formation of dislocations. In contrast, the aging-treated NiTi with unevenly-distributed and low-density Ni4Ti3 precipitate shows maximum recovery strain at 1st cycle compression and worst superelasticity stability. These results in this work can bring some meaningful insights into tailoring the microstructure and superelasticity of SLM NiTi SMAs.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究SLM制造NiTi合金的热处理与超弹性，未涉及多孔结构、应力遮挡或生物医学植入物评估。
llm.why_not_core: This paper does not link porous structure to stress shielding, does not report surface roughness or osseointegration, and focuses on superelasticity decay under compression rather than fatigue or implant-specific mechanical testing.

summary_zh.motivation: 探索热处理对SLM NiTi合金超弹性和微观结构的影响。
summary_zh.method: 通过SLM制备Ni50.4Ti49.6，进行固溶和时效处理，利用EBSD、SEM、TEM表征，并开展压缩循环测试。
summary_zh.result: 均匀细小Ni4Ti3析出相提升超弹性稳定性，不均匀析出相降低稳定性。
summary_zh.validation: 10次压缩循环实验验证超弹性衰减行为。

summary_en.motivation: To investigate how heat treatment modifies the phase transformation, microstructure, and superelasticity of SLM-fabricated NiTi shape memory alloys.
summary_en.method: Ni50.4Ti49.6 was fabricated by selective laser melting, followed by solution and aging treatments; microstructure was characterized by EBSD, SEM, and TEM, and superelasticity was evaluated through cyclic compression.
summary_en.result: Evenly distributed, high-density, fine Ni4Ti3 precipitates improved superelasticity stability, while uneven and low-density precipitates led to instability.
summary_en.validation: Cyclic compression tests (10 cycles) were used to assess superelasticity decay.

papers.title: Obesity and Primary Total Hip Arthroplasty: The Absolute versus Relative Risk of Periprosthetic Joint Infection at 15 Years
papers.first_author_affiliation: Department of Orthopedic Surgery, Mayo Clinic, Rochester, Minnesota

corresponding_authors.name: Christopher N. Carender
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Department of Orthopedic Surgery, Mayo Clinic, Rochester, Minnesota

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文仅讨论临床感染风险，未涉及任何生物力学分析或植入学研究。
llm.why_not_core: This paper is a clinical epidemiological study on infection risk after total hip arthroplasty and contains no biomechanical modeling, finite element analysis, stress shielding, micromotion, or implant design evaluation.

summary_zh.motivation: 评估肥胖对全髋关节置换术后15年感染风险的影响
summary_zh.method: 回顾性队列研究，比较不同BMI组的感染风险
summary_zh.result: 肥胖患者感染风险显著升高，但绝对风险差异较小
summary_zh.validation: 基于临床队列的统计分析

summary_en.motivation: To assess the impact of obesity on long-term periprosthetic joint infection risk after primary total hip arthroplasty.
summary_en.method: A retrospective cohort study comparing infection incidence across BMI categories over 15 years.
summary_en.result: Obese patients had a significantly higher relative risk of infection, though absolute risk differences were modest.
summary_en.validation: Statistical analysis of a clinical patient cohort with long-term follow-up.

papers.title: Innovative AI-driven design of patient-specific short femoral stems in primary hip arthroplasty
papers.abstract: This innovative study proposes a revolutionary strategy to enhance the efficacy and customization of hip arthroplasty, focusing on a short prosthesis design meticulously tailored to individual patient needs, with special emphasis on the femoral stem. The implemented methodology involves data collection through a meshless software, which quantifies the stress/strain shielding resulting from femoral insertion. Automatic pre-processing is performed using clustering algorithms, allowing the data to be divided into anatomical areas of the body. Subsequently, training of machine learning algorithms, such as random forests and stacking, is carried out to accurately predict the shielding caused by the stem. These predictions are based on design parameters, specifically linked to the patient's femoral cavity dimensions and their relationship to stem size, which are quantified through dimensionless parameters and serve as model inputs. The reliability of the models is confirmed by evaluation of data from patient with different femoral morphology than those used during the training and validation phases. This approach not only provides fast and cost-effective analyses for medical experts and engineers, but the described methodology can also be successfully extended to the development of alternative arthroplasty prostheses, such as shoulder and knee implants.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文直接针对短股骨柄的应力遮挡预测，但未涉及微动和接触建模。
llm.why_not_core: This paper does not report micromotion values, does not include contact/friction modeling, and does not explicitly compare intact vs implanted femur in Gruen zones.

summary_zh.motivation: 提高髋关节置换术中短股骨柄的个性化设计。
summary_zh.method: 使用无网格软件量化应力遮挡，结合聚类和机器学习（随机森林、堆叠）预测遮挡。
summary_zh.result: 模型能准确预测不同股骨形态患者的应力遮挡。
summary_zh.validation: 用不同形态患者数据验证模型可靠性。

summary_en.motivation: To enhance customization of short femoral stems in hip arthroplasty by predicting stress shielding.
summary_en.method: Quantify stress/strain shielding using meshless software, then apply clustering and ML (random forest, stacking) to predict shielding based on femoral cavity dimensions.
summary_en.result: The models accurately predict shielding for patients with different femoral morphologies.
summary_en.validation: Validation performed on a patient with different femoral morphology than training data.
